chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khathʿamī narrated from him, peace be upon him:
"Do not go out on Friday for any need; then when it is Saturday and the sun has risen, go out for your need."

key_terms.حَاجَةٍ: a need, errand, or purpose for which one goes out
key_terms.طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun has risen, marking the recommended time to go out
key_terms.فَاخْرُجْ: then go out, an instruction permitting departure at that time
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day on which going out for a need is discouraged here
key_terms.يَوْمُ السَّبْتِ: Saturday, the day mentioned as suitable instead

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about going out for one's needs on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance about a disliked time for setting out for one's needs, advising against going out on Friday and instead recommending departure on Saturday after sunrise. It reflects adab and practical legal guidance concerning choosing times for travel or worldly pursuits.
